messages.snippet: Margaret, Priya, Draft term sheet attached for your review. Headline terms as discussed: GBP 12,000,
messages.subject: Project Lumen - Series B Term Sheet (draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Margaret, Priya,

Draft term sheet attached for your review. Headline terms as discussed: GBP 12,000,000 subscription for 3,000,000 Series B preference shares at GBP 4.00 (GBP 40m pre-money / GBP 52m post), 1x non-participating liquidation preference, broad-based weighted-average anti-dilution, a 12% enlarged option pool on a pre-money basis, one Investor Director plus an observer, a 45-day exclusivity period and a costs cap of GBP 40,000. Target completion end of March 2024.

Let me know if the commercial points land where you want them before we send to Hargrove.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
